title: My love and opinion on games and fan games
author: Ok-Effective1678
selftext: To be completely honest with you all: I enjoy developing fan games way more than making my own original games! When you work all by yourself on a project, grabbing people’s attention with something nobody has ever seen before is a huge challenge. It takes a long time for players to discover, get used to, and truly connect with a brand-new universe. With a crossover, though, it’s a whole different story—catching people's eyes and getting them excited is so much easier! On top of that, there’s a special kind of magic in creating playable crossovers using sprites made from scratch in a retro style. Taking iconic characters, crafting them from the ground up in that classic old-school video game aesthetic, and bringing them together in action hits you with an incredible wave of nostalgia. It’s just so much fun, both to make and to play! And there’s one more detail at the very end that I really love: the end credits! Because I work solo, the credits in an original game end up super short and fly by in the blink of an eye. In fan games, however, it’s completely different—I get to turn the finale into a grand celebration packed with praise and tributes, just like movie end credits! Of course, at the end of the day, both original games and fan games have their own advantages. What about you guys—which one do you like more?

comments.author: delicious_pubes
comments.body: Fan games have always been a great thing. Share what you make to people who enjoy the same worlds, just don’t try and sell it and no one will be mad
